name: Argoth
description: A sub-continent sunk by the Sylex Blast.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argoth Forest is ravaged during the rule of the artificers, and its Pixies turn their magic to practical ends.
timeline.quote: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers

citation.text: Argothian Pixies (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gaea instills a portion of her power into vengeful followers after Argoth's destruction.
timeline.quote: Gaea was willing to instill a portion of her own powers into some of her more vengeful followers.

citation.text: Gaea's Avenger (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arcum Dagsson wishes the forces that took Argoth never return.
timeline.quote: "May the forces that took Argoth beneath the waves never come among us again."

citation.text: Stone Rain (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mishra's helix reflects his strategy that if he couldn't have Argoth no one could.
timeline.quote: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

citation.text: Mishra's Helix (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gamelen proclaims the first seedling of Argoth sprouted here and the last tree will fall here.
timeline.quote: Here the last tree will fall.

citation.text: Gaea's Cradle (World Championship Decks 1999, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
timeline.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Last Battle on Argoth moments before the sylex detonates.
timeline.quote: Argoth. The Last Battle. Moments before the end of the world, again.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes time at the moment of detonation, finds nothing, then takes a reckless risk and stops holding back time; the Multiverse tears open.
timeline.quote: The Multiverse tore open.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
timeline.quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and breaks and the dark rushes in as Urza starts to ask Teferi's name.
timeline.quote: The void broke.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Loran escapes in 57 AR without the Sylex, and Ashnod follows Mishra to Argoth.
timeline.quote: Ashnod decided to follow him there.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth.
timeline.quote: The ensuing Sylex Blast destroyed both armies and the island of Argoth.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast devours Argoth; Crucias's ship is caught in the blast, ending Crucias's tale and starting Bo Levar's.
timeline.quote: the Sylex Blast devoured the island itself in light.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Captain Crucias". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Last Battle at Argoth the brothers meet at the head of their armies and Urza finds Mishra corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered there that Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ignites his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles, sank the sub-continent of Argoth

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The blast ignites Urza's spark, giving him his first brief planeswalk.
timeline.quote: caused the ignition of Urza's planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth turns the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague that eats away the elves.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague that ate away the elves there.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth kidnaps the priestess Elyssendril and her healers and extorts the elves.
timeline.quote: When the elves paid, he delivered only sweetened water and 12 dead healers to them.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elyssendril is sent as a delegate to Halcyon against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Elyssendril survived and was later part of the delegates sent to Halcyon on behalf of the Thran Alliance against Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin is helped by an Argothian elf and tells Urza of the island.
timeline.quote: When, millennia later, Harbin stumbled upon Argoth, he was helped by an Argothian elf.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, starting the Battle at Argoth.
timeline.quote: He also lured both brothers to Argoth

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In remorse, Urza performs the Sylex's ritual with his blood, grief and pain and activates it.
timeline.quote: He spoke the words of the inscription, and the sylex activated.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth, begins the Ice Age and ignites Urza's spark.
timeline.quote: Caught at the epicenter of the blast, Urza's spark ignited.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Argoth Urza reveals Mishra as a construct of flesh and Phyrexian metal and destroys him and the forest; Urza ascends as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Urza released an enormous burst of power that destroyed both Mishra and the sentient forest

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Death and afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves flee the expanding Thran empire to Argoth.
timeline.quote: The elves of Terisiare fled the expanding empire to the island of Argoth .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argoth is obliterated when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex in the last battle.
timeline.quote: Completely obliterated in the last battle of the War, when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Terisiare exhausted, both brothers rush to exploit Argoth's forests and mineral wealth.
timeline.quote: They rushed to exploit it, each certain that possession of the island would assure him of a final victory.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final months-long battle at Argoth, Urza and Tawnos emerge victorious and the island is a smoking ruin.
timeline.quote: When he battle was over, Urza and Tawnos emerged victorious, and Argoth was a smoking ruin.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod are almost certainly killed, while Urza and Tawnos disappear, perhaps by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod were almost certainly killed in the conflagration, but no concrete evidence exists of this.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza discovers Argoth, Gix feeds the information to Mishra, and both brothers invade the island.
timeline.quote: By chance, Urza discovers the untouched island of Argoth to the southeast

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
timeline.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra fight directly; Urza sees Mishra has replaced his flesh with machinery.
timeline.quote: Urza sees that Mishra has replaced his flesh with machinery like the Gixians

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza releases the Sylex's energy, destroying Argoth and obliterating both armies.
timeline.quote: the resulting explosion destroys Argoth

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza survives the blast and ascends as a planeswalker with his eyes replaced by the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: Urza survives the Sylex blast and ascends, becoming a planeswalker

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The final battle of the Brothers' War takes place on Argoth.
timeline.quote: the final battle of the Brothers' War takes place on the island of Argoth .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, obliterating Argoth, and becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex , obliterating Argoth

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin discovers Argoth and the Combined Kingdoms invade it; Gix lures Urza and Mishra there.
timeline.quote: Gix also lures Urza and Mishra to Argoth in order to make them face each other physically.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
timeline.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza activates the Sylex.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argothian treefolk are thought to have become extinct when the final battle of the Brothers' War raged across their forest.
timeline.quote: The treefolk of the old forest of Argoth are thought to have become extinct when the final battle of the Brothers' War raged across their forest.

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Argothian Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Argoth Urza discovers Mishra has been corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
timeline.quote: Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence, slowly turning himself from a man into a living machine

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, destroying both armies, sinking Argoth and leading to the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles around, sank the sub-continent Argoth

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the moment of the blast Urza meets Teferi beyond time, his body is remade with the Mightstone and Weakstone as eyes, and his spark ignites.
timeline.quote: igniting his latent planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
timeline.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
